title: PasswordPolicy
description: A credential rule set that fixes the length bounds, required character classes, reuse history, expiry interval and failed-attempt lockout for memorized secrets (passwords or passphrases) accepted by an authenticator. It covers only the rules a password must satisfy and how repeated failures are handled, not how the principal is authenticated overall. Use AuthenticationConfig instead when the symbol configures the identity provider, MFA, session timeout or verification level, of which password rules are at most one referenced part. Use ValidationRule instead when a regex, length or range check validates an ordinary data field rather than the composition of a login credential. Use Countermeasure instead when the code implements a general brute-force or credential-stuffing mitigation (IP throttling, CAPTCHA, breached-password screening) not expressed as password composition or account lockout parameters.

minLength.description: Minimum number of characters a password must contain; set whenever a lower length bound is enforced (NIST SP 800-63B suggests at least 8, commonly 12+).

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters accepted for a password; set only when the system caps length, and leave unset if no cap exists.

requireUppercase.description: True when a password must contain at least one uppercase letter (A-Z); omit or set false when no such rule is enforced.

requireLowercase.description: True when a password must contain at least one lowercase letter (a-z); omit or set false when no such rule is enforced.

requireNumbers.description: True when a password must contain at least one decimal digit (0-9); omit or set false when no such rule is enforced.

requireSpecialChars.description: True when a password must contain at least one non-alphanumeric symbol; omit or set false when no such rule is enforced.

preventReuse.description: Number of previous passwords per account that a new password may not match; 0 or unset means no history check.

expiryDays.description: Number of days after which a password must be changed; use 0 when passwords never expire by age.

lockoutAttempts.description: Number of consecutive failed authentication attempts that triggers account lockout; leave unset when no lockout is enforced.

lockoutDuration.description: Length of time, in minutes, that an account stays locked after reaching lockoutAttempts; use 0 when unlock requires administrator action.

x-dr-standard: NIST SP 800-53 IA-5(1) Password-Based Authentication (with AC-7 Unsuccessful Logon Attempts for lockout)
x-dr-evidence: Framework password option blocks such as Django AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS (MinimumLengthValidator), ASP.NET Identity PasswordOptions/LockoutOptions, or Spring Security password constraint beans.

Identity-provider or infrastructure declarations such as a Keycloak realm passwordPolicy string ('length(12) and upperCase(1) and passwordHistory(5)'), an AWS Cognito PasswordPolicy block, or a Terraform aws_iam_account_password_policy resource.

A password-change or registration routine that tests character-class regexes, compares the new hash against stored previous hashes, and returns messages like 'Password must contain a special character', or a failed-login counter that sets a locked-until timestamp.
